newsitem.title: BRAZIL: MOTOR RACING-PIQUET TRIUMPHS ON HOME TRACK.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-PIQUET TRIUMPHS ON HOME TRACK.

text.p: Three times Formula One world champion Nelson Piquet won his first international sportscar race on his home circuit of Curitiba on Sunday.

The Brazilian, sharing a McLaren GTR with ex-motorcycle world champion Johnny Cecotto of Venezuela, triumphed in the BPR GT Two Hours ahead of a similar car driven by the French-Brazilian pairing of Fabien Giroix and Maurizio Sala.
Only 8.8 seconds separated the leading two cars at the finish.
